newsitem.title: CANADA: MAAX wins C$50 mln three-year Japan deal.
newsitem.headline: MAAX wins C$50 mln three-year Japan deal.

text.p: MAAX Inc said on Tuesday that it signed an agreement worth more than C$50 million over the next three years with S.G. Kai Ltd, in Tokyo.

The contract, which is the largest ever for MAAX, relates to the manufacture of modular units designed specifically for bathrooms in hotel, condominiums and residential buildings, and includes all components. The project will create 50 to 100 jobs within the next two years at the company's facilities in Sainte-Marie-de-Beauce, Quebec.
Initial deliveries will will be made at the rate of 10 units a day at the end of January 1997.
The agreement will allow MAAX to exceed its three-year objective of recording 6 percent of its sales on international markets, excluding the U.S. market, the company said.
S.G. Kai is an association which includes the 220-largest building contractors in Japan, MAAX said. MAAX is a manufacturer of bathroom fixtures and accessories.
